common_name: Green's Blush Camellia (Pale Pink Single Sasanqua)

planting.note: Plant container shrubs in fall or early spring in moist, well-drained, acidic (pH 5.0-6.5), humus-rich soil in partial shade to full sun; Green's Blush bears pale, soft pink single flowers with a gentle, understated look.

directions: Plant in moist, well-drained, acidic soil in partial shade to full sun; Green's Blush bears single to semi-double flowers in a pale, delicate pink with a soft golden stamen cluster, a gentler and more understated color than the bolder pinks and reds common among sasanqua cultivars. It flowers from October into December in zone 9, providing cool-season color when few other shrubs are blooming, on a vigorous, upright plant with glossy evergreen foliage that also works well as a hedge or espalier. As with all camellias, provide consistent moisture and a protective mulch layer over the shallow root system, and prune immediately after flowering ends to avoid removing next season's buds.

planting.note: Plant container shrubs in fall or early spring in moist, well-drained, acidic (pH 5.0-6.5), humus-rich soil in partial shade to full sun; Autumn Sunset bears an unusual apricot-orange toned pink flower color rare among sasanqua cultivars.

directions: Plant in moist, well-drained, acidic soil in partial shade to full sun; Autumn Sunset bears semi-double flowers in an unusual warm apricot-orange blush over pink, a color rarely seen in sasanqua camellias, which lean mostly toward pinks, reds, and whites. It flowers heavily from fall into early winter, providing warm-toned cool-season color that pairs distinctively with the cooler pinks and whites of companion camellias. Its vigorous, upright growth and glossy evergreen foliage suit hedging and screening as well as specimen use. As with all camellias, maintain consistent moisture and a protective mulch layer over the shallow root system, and prune only right after flowering to avoid removing the following season's buds.
